content:
Maya (AE): Heads-up 1 EdgeCorp exec escalation. POC live-captioning pipeline is dropping connections & missing tokens during burst traffic. CTO insists on deterministic websocket throughput and wants either VPC/private deployment or on-prem. Exec bridge requested tomorrow 08:30 UTC. We need a short validation plan + delta on pricing for a reserved private install.

Arjun (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: are clients streaming token-by-token (server push) or buffering chunks? Which model variant are they prototyping? Also need expected average tokens/sec per connection.

Maya (AE): They said token-by-token streaming (server push). Target workload: ~800 concurrent websockets, typical message ~900B, bursts up to 1400 requests/sec across the cluster. Model they were testing: redwood-13b-opt (streaming-optimized). Acceptance they gave: p99 token latency under 100ms for 256-512 token windows.

Rosa (Infra Eng): Notes from infra POV: websocket scale is connection-heavy, TLS + sticky sessions required. For burst tolerance we need connection affinity and a fronted rate limiter (NGINX/Envoy) + token-bucket per-conn. For an initial private/VPC install I'd size 6 x A10G (gpu-packed) with 3 control-plane replicas. Also need permanent peering (BGP or PrivateLink) and customer NACLs. Will run a capacity calc.

Arjun (SE): To validate performance I'll need a reproducible harness and the exact pattern. Example load command I can share for them to run or for us against staging:

```\n# ws load (simplified)\n./ws_load --url wss://edgecorp-poc/ws \\n  --concurrency 800 --burst 1400 --payload 900 \\n  --streaming --model redwood-13b-opt --max-tokens 512\\n```\n
I'll run that against our staging runtime and capture p50/p95/p99 token latencies, total dropped connections, and reconnect behavior.

Nadia (Compliance): EdgeCorp operates in FR; they flagged CNIL plus Schrems II. They require DPA + SCC addendum and proof of EU-only subprocessors for this engagement. For private/on-prem installs they want a security questionnaire (yes) and a BYOK/HSM attestation. We can supply SOC2/ISO docs. I'll assemble a quick risks summary for the bridge.

Ben (Head of Sales): Commercial ask from customer: 30% off committed cluster + pilot credits. Our standard for 12mo reserved on private is 20% + 2 months free. We can approve up to 25% with CRO signoff if total ARR > $500k. Any extra compliance engineering is billable. I'll join the exec bridge.

Maya (AE): Action items for tomorrow's bridge 08:30 UTC: Arjun -> deliver harness + smoke run (EOD), Rosa -> capacity calc + network checklist + rough infra price (EOD), Nadia -> DPA/SCC summary + list of requested docs (EOD), Ben -> commercial position + fallback offer. Calendar invite sent.

calendar-bot: "EdgeCorp exec bridge" scheduled 1 2026-04-05 08:30 UTC. Invites sent to EdgeCorp CTO + Redwood attendees.

Arjun (SE): Quick update: uploaded harness to staging and kicked a smoke run at 16:30 UTC. Initial numbers: p50 token latency ~28ms, p95 ~82ms, p99 ~138ms; connection drop ~0.8% under simulated burst. Attaching logs link and sample output. We need tuning on KV cache + connection distribution.

Rosa (Infra Eng): Thanks. I'll take Arjun's logs and model the cluster behavior. If p99 stays >100ms under realistic bursts we either increase node count or tune batching thresholds. Proposed acceptance criteria to propose on bridge: p99 <100ms, sustained 30 minutes at 800 conns, drop rate <0.3%.

Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll prep the customer agenda with those acceptance criteria and include the commercial anchor (20% + 2 months) and our negotiable range. See you all on the bridge. :thumbsup:
